aboutText: Zimmer Built is based in Coburg North, with a rich background in joinery and stair building. Our expertise spans both residential and commercial fitouts across Melbourne, with a design philosophy rooted in mid-century proportion and Japanese joinery detail. We specialise in creating custom furniture and seamless joinery that stands the test of time.
servicesText: We offer a range of joinery services from custom furniture to complete fitouts. Our team handles everything from design to installation, ensuring quality craftsmanship for both residential and commercial projects in Melbourne.
